messages:
carla: Evening handoff — I'm stepping off in ~15. Quick bullets: canary v3.2 rolled to 10% at 13:20 UTC, saw a short CPU spike on embed-worker, dedicated eu-west maintenance scheduled 02:00 UTC, and watch redis-staging kv-ttl churn. Action: @brian please monitor canary errors and latencies; I left runbook notes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance 'dedicated-eu' planned for 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC — expected brief node reboot window.

brian: On it. Any prefetched endpoints we should disable for the canary?

carla: Search prefetch ok. Please disable long-tail batch prefetching on canary nodes — set PREFETCH_LONGTAIL=false in the canary config. I'll add the exact flag to the runbook.

alice: Saw a few 429s to /v1/generate around 13:35 — looks like greedy batching hitting limits. Filed INF-412. @carla do you want us to bump the rate-limit to 60rpm for the canary group temporarily?

carla: Don't bump limits. We want to observe real throttling. If errors go >0.5% revert to model-xsmall fallback.

brian: ACK. I'll watch metrics and set an alert: error_rate > 0.7% OR p95 > 750ms triggers rollback.

devex-sig: FYI PR #1892 (canary config) still needs infra lgtm. Pinged @alice and @frank for review.

alice: I'll do a quick smoke in staging and merge if clean.

carla: Smoke check I ran: `kubectl -n inference exec -t deploy/canary -- curl -sS http://localhost:8000/health | jq .` -> {"status":"ok"}. Logs snippet from embed-worker: ```[13:40:12] embed-worker: warning: batch size auto-trim -> 64```

brian: I'll tail logs during the window: `stern canary -n inference --since 10m` and keep an eye on cpu/mem.

alice: :thumbsup: leaving a brief note in shift doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall/shift-2026-03-18

carla: Final action list before I sign off: 1) set dashboard alerts (brian), 2) merge PR (alice), 3) open follow-up ticket to check post-maintenance error trend (brian). I'm reachable by phone if bridge needed.

oncall-bot: No active incidents.

brian: Copy that. Adding to my watchlist now; will post updates here if anything degrades.

alice: One more: kv-evict job had a 504 earlier and retried successfully — job logs: https://ci.internal/job/kv-evict/123 — keep an eye on eviction backlog after maintenance.

carla: Thanks all, leaving notes in pager duty and the runbook.
